title: Post-Punk
tagline: Restless rhythm, open-ended guitars, and a refusal to stand still.
summary: Post-punk grew from punk's energy into an expansive approach to songwriting and sound. Artists kept punk's urgency while borrowing from dub, funk, electronic music, art schools, and experimental pop. The result was a network of scenes connected through records and venues. Its influence remains wherever bands treat rhythm, texture, and production as boldly as the song.
origin_place: United Kingdom and the United States

pillars.name: Joy Division
pillars.why: Joy Division paired stark arrangements with a propulsive rhythm section, helping establish one influential direction for post-punk.

pillars.name: Public Image Ltd
pillars.why: Public Image Ltd stretched punk forms with dub space, shifting lineups, and abrasive experimentation.

pillars.name: Wire
pillars.why: Wire's concise songs and changing structures showed how much invention could fit inside a short, direct performance.
